basis: Immunodeficiency, neutropenia with myelokathexis, and chronic cutaneous warts are defining features.
Adenocarcinoma arising in salivary glands, predominantly minor glands of the palate.
Congenital neutrophil maturation failure causes severe neutropenia and innate immunodeficiency; recurrent infections are separate diseases.
Treponemal infection causes persistent papillomatous and ulcerative skin lesions; destructive bone disease is not established in >=30% across all stages.
Autoimmune necrotizing vasculitis; glomerulonephritis occurs in roughly 60-80% and direct pulmonary inflammation or hemorrhage in roughly 40-60%.
Cerebral vascular amyloid causes neurodegeneration; progressive cataracts and sensorineural deafness occur in nearly all classically affected patients.
Neorickettsia infects monocytes/macrophages and causes a mononucleosis-like illness; no established common lasting extrahematologic organ damage.
Extraskeletal osteosarcoma originates in the kidney; osteoid production does not establish skeletal involvement.
Premature fusion of bicoronal and sagittal skull sutures; neurologic damage is not inherent to this nonsyndromic concept.
The definition specifies skeletal and muscle abnormalities together with neurologic defects.
Developmental absence or severe deficiency of the telencephalon; the affected organ is the brain.
Intellectual and language impairment define the disorder; high myopia affects 1/2 reported patients. Recurrent otitis is a separate infection.
Hypertrophy of nasal skin sebaceous glands and dermal fibrosis; the lesion is cutaneous rather than an airway disorder.
Distal arthrogryposis with finger contractures, ulnar deviation and structural foot deformity.
Progressive myoclonic epilepsy with neurologic deterioration; Lafora bodies alone do not establish functional damage in other organs.
Benign epidermal keratinocytic lesion located on the eyelid, involving both skin and an explicitly included ocular structure.
Optic nerve hypoplasia affects 3/5 and strabismus 9/12; fixed foot contractures occur in 30-79%. Constipation and dysphagia do not establish intrinsic GI damage.
Skeletal dysplasia occurs in 80-99%; cap excludes renal anomalies (~2/3), GI dysfunction (~2/3) and hearing impairment (30-79%).
Disorder of blood-pressure regulation; an abnormal reflex does not establish structural brain disease or neurologic damage.
Clonal proliferation of hematopoietic stem-cell descendants; subsequent malignancy and cardiovascular disease are risks, not direct involvement.
Peripheral neuropathy with persistent distal amyotrophy and pes cavus in 80-99%; Achilles contractures in 5/8. Hearing impairment is below 30%.
Autoimmune myositis and ILD define the syndrome; mechanic hands are a characteristic persistent hyperkeratotic lesion (~30-40%). Raynaud alone is not vascular damage.
Inherited retinal photoreceptor dysfunction causes progressive visual impairment; no established extraocular disease.
BLNK-related antibody deficiency; infections are separate diseases. Enteropathy (1/1) and neutropenia (1/2) do not establish common direct lasting organ damage.
Intellectual disability and skeletal/joint abnormalities define the syndrome; heart malformations affect ~40-50%, and dental structural abnormalities occur in 30-79%.
